{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 6:30). Nobody spoke while I was there; no hand labels visible. Picture shows the whole fish still dark/connected: nose, both body arcs, crossing near (23,10), both tail tips. Nothing pale or stranded. Lower tail (about 25.5-27, 13-15) is still standing and connected, though tightly bunched. That is a possible weak point for the push, but it is holding. Team appears to be following the hands-off rule.

Maya: No new observation. Earlier she volunteered that she nudged a domino near the lower tail, and that tail is still intact. Good ownership and communication. Still don't know what she built.

Leo: No new observation. Earlier he set a clear stop-touching rule and repeated it. Good process and leadership. His connectivity claim held up by the picture. Still need his own build contribution.

Priya: No new observation. She backed hands-off and said the back line looks solid. Too little evidence to rate her on impact or execution.

Tom: Absent from my view again, silent for two visits. No evidence either way. I must not assume he did nothing, and I must not rate him until I ask him directly.

Next visit: ask each person privately what they built and who did what. Ask Tom first. Check the lower tail again before the push. Hold off on ratings until I have more than the shared picture, since I can't tell who placed which domino."}
